name: Handwraps of Mighty Blows +3 (Battle Form House Rule)

description.value:
Homebrew: this is a patched copy of Handwraps of Mighty Blows, made of high-grade cold iron and pre-etched with this character's actual runes (+3 potency, major striking, Brilliant (Greater), Holy, Shock (Greater)), with an added house rule: those runes' bonuses AND the cold iron material still apply while transformed by a battle form (Wild Shape/Untamed Form's Wolf, Dinosaur, Dragon Form, etc.), on top of the form's own fixed attack/damage. Drag this onto your sheet in place of your normal Handwraps, and update the numbers below if your runes or material change.

As you invest these embroidered strips of cloth, you must meditate and slowly wrap them around your hands. These handwraps have weapon runes etched into them to give your unarmed attacks the benefits of those runes, making your unarmed attacks work like magic weapons.

You can upgrade, add, and transfer runes to and from the handwraps just as you would for a weapon, and you can attach talismans to the handwraps. Treat the handwraps as melee weapons of the brawling group with light Bulk for these purposes. Property runes apply only when they would be applicable to the unarmed attack you're using.

House rule (battle forms) Normally, a battle form (from Wild Shape's Untamed Form, or any other polymorph battle form) replaces your unarmed attack's attack modifier and damage with its own fixed values, discarding any runes or materials you're carrying. At this table, if you're wearing and have invested these handwraps, their runes' bonuses and cold iron material still apply on top of the battle form's own attack/damage while you're transformed:

  • +3 item bonus to unarmed attack rolls (potency)
  • Greater Brilliant: +1d4 fire damage, plus +1d4 spirit damage against fiends and +1d4 vitality damage against undead. On a critical hit, the target must succeed at a Fortitude save (DC = your class DC) or be blinded for 1 round, and this damage ignores fire/spirit/vitality resistance.
  • Holy: +1d4 spirit damage (+2d4 total against unholy creatures). Once per day, on a critical hit against an unholy creature you may spend a reaction to regain HP equal to double that creature's level.
  • Greater Shock: +1d6 electricity damage. On a critical hit, electricity arcs to up to 2 other creatures within 10 feet for the same damage. This damage ignores electricity resistance.
  • Your unarmed attacks count as cold iron (bypassing resistances/vulnerabilities keyed to that material, e.g. against fey and demons).
